input.one_liner: For Indian millet breeders, use the TiHAN/ICRISAT UAV hyperspectral pearl-millet dataset to output the earliest flight date when water-stress separation is trustworthy by genotype group.
input.constraints_C9:
C9_feasibility:
    timeline_months: 8
    mode: part_time
    compute:
      local: macbook_no_cuda
      rule: >
        NO sustained local GPU training. Candidate must run on free hosted
        compute: Google Earth Engine, Copernicus Data Space, Microsoft
        Planetary Computer, Kaggle free GPU hours, Colab free tier.
      fail_if: requires multi-day GPU training or >30 GPU-hours/week
    budget_myr: 200
    data:
      preferred: open
      free_sources: [sentinel_1, sentinel_2, landsat, nicfi_asia, lpis, eurocrops, openstreetmap]
      nicfi_licence_check: >
        NICFI is non-commercial AND purpose-bound to reducing tropical forest
        loss. An India/SEA candidate using NICFI must frame around agricultural
        expansion, deforestation-free commodities, or forest-edge farming.
        Generic yield prediction on NICFI = LICENCE FAIL.
    coding_capacity: high
    fail_if_data: no accessible dataset named, or ground truth does not exist
input.constraints_C2_sensor_rules:
sensor_rules:
      applies_when: candidate is imagery-based
      singapore:
        allowed: [drone, uav, aerial, sub_metre_commercial]
        forbidden: [sentinel_scale, landsat_scale]
        reason: >
          Singapore farmland is <1% of land area (<10 km2). Average vegetable
          farm ~2 ha. At Sentinel-2 10 m that is ~20x10 px — unusable.
        extra_check: >
          Self-collected drone flights are OUT OF SCOPE (permits, cost, access).
          Candidate MUST name an existing, accessible imagery source or FAIL.
      india:
        note: NICFI 4.77 m available via GEE, but licence-restricted (see C9).
      eu:
        note: >
          NICFI does NOT cover the EU (tropics only). Sentinel-1/2, LPIS parcel
          data, EuroCrops available. Most crowded literature — novelty bar is
          highest here.
      malaysia:
        allowed: [sentinel_scale, landsat_scale, nicfi, drone, uav, aerial, sub_metre_commercial]
        note: >
          Estates (oil palm, rubber, durian) are large enough for Sentinel scale.
          Smallholder plots (<4 ha, ~40% of oil palm) need NICFI or sub-metre.
          NICFI covers Malaysia but the C9 purpose-bound licence check applies:
          frame around deforestation-free commodities / EUDR / forest-edge.
          Cameron Highlands is cloud-locked most of the year — SAR is the
          realistic optical substitute there.
        extra_check: >
          Self-collected drone flights are OUT OF SCOPE here too. Name an
          existing accessible source (open dataset, national orthophoto, or a
          partner company's archive with written access) or FAIL.
        local_forcing_functions:
          - EUDR palm-oil obligations from 30 Dec 2026 (MSPO ↔ EUDR alignment)
          - MPOB smallholder replanting incentive verification
          - drone service firms (Aonic, Aerodyne, Meraque) as named users
